parameters.query:
WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.fr_papers (
    id,
    document_number,
    title,
    agency,
    abstract,
    document_type,
    publication_date,
    declared_publication_date,
    source_stream,
    filing_type,
    filing_tag,
    status,
    html_url,
    pdf_url,
    comment_url,
    filed_at,
    process_after_date,
    raw_json,
    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at
  )
  VALUES (
    '{{ ($json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.document_number || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.title || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.agency || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.abstract || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.document_type || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    NULLIF('{{ $json.publication_date || "" }}', '')::date,
    NULLIF('{{ $json.declared_publication_date || "" }}', '')::date,
    '{{ ($json.source_stream || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.filing_type || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.filing_tag || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.status || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.html_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.pdf_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.comment_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    NULLIF('{{ $json.filed_at || "" }}', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF('{{ $json.process_after_date || "" }}', '')::date,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_json || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    document_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.document_number, ''), fr_papers.document_number),
    title = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.title, ''), fr_papers.title),
    agency = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.agency, ''), fr_papers.agency),
    abstract = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.abstract, ''), fr_papers.abstract),
    document_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.document_type, ''), fr_papers.document_type),
    publication_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.publication_date, fr_papers.publication_date),
    declared_publication_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.declared_publication_date, fr_papers.declared_publication_date),
    source_stream = EXCLUDED.source_stream,
    filing_type = CASE
      WHEN fr_papers.filing_tag = 'SPECIAL_PUBLIC_INSPECTION' THEN 'special'
      ELSE EXCLUDED.filing_type
    END,
    filing_tag = CASE
      WHEN fr_papers.filing_tag = 'SPECIAL_PUBLIC_INSPECTION' THEN fr_papers.filing_tag
      WHEN EXCLUDED.filing_tag = 'SPECIAL_PUBLIC_INSPECTION' THEN EXCLUDED.filing_tag
      ELSE EXCLUDED.filing_tag
    END,
    status = CASE
      WHEN EXCLUDED.source_stream = 'federal_register' THEN 'published'
      ELSE EXCLUDED.status
    END,
    html_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.html_url, ''), fr_papers.html_url),
    pdf_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.pdf_url, ''), fr_papers.pdf_url),
    comment_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.comment_url, ''), fr_papers.comment_url),
    filed_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.filed_at, fr_papers.filed_at),
    process_after_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.process_after_date, fr_papers.process_after_date),
    raw_json = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.raw_json, fr_papers.raw_json),
    last_seen_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT *,
  (
    source_stream = 'federal_register'
    AND publication_date <= CURRENT_DATE
    AND COALESCE(email_sent, false) = false
    AND COALESCE(processor_status, '') NOT IN ('SEND', 'DO_NOT_SEND', 'NOT_RELEVANT')
  ) AS should_process_now
FROM upsert;

UPDATE public.fr_papers
SET
  relevance_score = {{ $json.relevance_score || 0 }},
  matched_animal_terms = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.matched_animal_terms || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  matched_animal_agencies = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.matched_animal_agencies || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  ai_decision = 'NOT_RELEVANT',
  processor_status = 'NOT_RELEVANT',
  processed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ ($json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING id, title, processor_status;

UPDATE public.fr_papers
SET
  relevance_score = {{ $json.relevance_score || 0 }},
  matched_animal_terms = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.matched_animal_terms || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  matched_animal_agencies = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.matched_animal_agencies || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  ai_decision = 'DO_NOT_SEND',
  ai_summary = '{{ ($json.ai_content || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ai_raw_response = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.openrouter_raw || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  processor_status = 'DO_NOT_SEND',
  processed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ ($json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING id, title, processor_status;

const doc = $input.first().json; const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); const isSpecial = doc.filing_tag === "SPECIAL_PUBLIC_INSPECTION"; const email_subject = isSpecial ? `Federal Paws SPECIAL Filing Alert — ${doc.publication_date || today}` : `Federal Paws Animal Advocacy Alert — ${doc.publication_date || today}`; const header = isSpecial ? `SPECIAL PUBLIC INSPECTION FOLLOW-UP This item was first tracked as a special Public Inspection filing and is now being processed through the published Federal Register pipeline.` : `PUBLISHED FEDERAL REGISTER UPDATE This item is from the official published Federal Register pipeline.`; const verification = `Verification instructions: 1. Open the official Federal Register source link. 2. Confirm the agency, publication date, document number, and any comment deadline. 3. Confirm whether the action is still open before using this as advocacy guidance.`; const email_text = `Federal Paws Animal Advocacy Notice ${doc.publication_date || today} ${header} Filing Tag: ${doc.filing_tag || "FEDERAL_REGISTER_PUBLISHED"} Document Number: ${doc.document_number || "Unknown"} Agency: ${doc.agency || "Unknown"} Official Source: ${doc.html_url || "No URL"} Comment Link: ${doc.comment_url || "None"} ${doc.ai_content || doc.ai_summary || doc.abstract || "Summary unavailable. Please review the official Federal Register notice."} ${verification} --- This represents informational guidance only and not legal advice. Federal Paws | Open Paws`; const email_html = `

Federal Paws Animal Advocacy Notice

${doc.publication_date || today}

${isSpecial ? "Special Public Inspection Follow-Up" : "Published Federal Register Update"}

${header.replace(/\n/g, "
")}

Filing Tag ${doc.filing_tag || "FEDERAL_REGISTER_PUBLISHED"}
Document Number ${doc.document_number || "Unknown"}
Agency ${doc.agency || "Unknown"}
${(doc.ai_content || doc.ai_summary || doc.abstract || "Summary unavailable. Please review the official Federal Register notice.").replace(/\n/g, "
")}

View Official Federal Register Notice

Verification instructions

  1. Open the official Federal Register source link.
  2. Confirm the agency, publication date, document number, and any comment deadline.
  3. Confirm whether the action is still open before using this as advocacy guidance.

This represents informational guidance only and not legal advice.

Federal Paws | Open Paws
`; return [ { json: { ...doc, email_subject, email_text, email_html } } ];

WITH source AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.paper_id || $json.id || $("Build Email Template1").item.json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS paper_id,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb AS payload
),
valid_paper AS (
  SELECT fp.id AS paper_id
  FROM public.fr_papers fp
  JOIN source s ON fp.id = s.paper_id
)
INSERT INTO public.fr_processing_events (
  paper_id,
  event_type,
  event_message,
  event_payload,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  valid_paper.paper_id,
  'EMAIL_SENT',
  'Email was sent and database was updated.',
  source.payload,
  NOW()
FROM valid_paper
CROSS JOIN source
RETURNING id, paper_id, event_type, created_at;

parameters.content:
## 1. Webhook security
Purpose: accept only authorized processor calls.

Required env var:
`FEDERALPAWS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`

The request must send header:
`x-federalpaws-secret`

No `REPLACE_ME` fallback is allowed. This prevents accidental public access.

## 2. Normalize and upsert
Purpose: convert webhook body into one consistent Federal Register paper shape, then upsert it into `public.fr_papers`.

This protects downstream nodes from different source formats such as published docs, public inspection docs, or manual issue lookup records.

## 3. Keyword relevance gate
Purpose: cheap first-pass filter before AI.

Only records with animal terms in the title/abstract and enough score move to OpenRouter. Non-candidates are marked `NOT_RELEVANT` and logged.

## 4. OpenRouter summary path
Purpose: classify and summarize only records that passed keyword filtering.

Required env var:
`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`

Embeddings are intentionally removed from this MVP path because the previous workflow generated embeddings but did not compare them against reference vectors. That added failure points without improving relevance.

## 5. OpenRouter error handling
Purpose: do not hide AI/API failures as `DO_NOT_SEND`.

If OpenRouter returns an error, malformed response, missing key, invalid key, rate limit, or no `choices[0].message.content`, the workflow stores `OPENROUTER_ERROR` and logs the raw response.

## 6. Send or block
Purpose: make the final delivery decision.

`SEND` goes to email template, SMTP, DB update, and event log.

`DO_NOT_SEND` is stored as AI blocked and logged.

This keeps an audit trail for every relevant candidate.

## 7. Final audit trail
Purpose: prove what happened.

For sent emails, the workflow stores summary, raw AI response, email subject/body, `email_sent=true`, `email_sent_at`, and an `EMAIL_SENT` processing event.

SELECT
  string_agg(email, ',') AS recipient_email_list,
  COUNT(*)::int AS recipient_count
FROM public.subscribers
WHERE is_active = true
  AND email ~* '^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}$';

SET

  processed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ ($json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING id AS paper_id, title, processor_status, error_message;

## 8. Recipient lookup from PostgreSQL
Purpose: pull active subscriber email IDs from `public.fr_email_recipients` before sending.

The workflow aggregates active emails into one comma-separated BCC list. If no active recipients exist, it does not send an email and logs `NO_RECIPIENTS`.

Minimum table columns required:
`email text`, `is_active boolean`, `unsubscribed_at timestamptz`.
